security_audit.summary: Eleven findings are false positives: Markdown backticks, official public data URLs, an abbreviated URL, and readable multilingual text. Two findings confirm predictable temporary file writes that can overwrite existing files or follow attacker-created symbolic links. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential access, or data exfiltration.

remediation.issue: The download commands write to predictable shared temporary paths, allowing file collisions and symbolic link attacks.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private temporary directory with mktemp -d, quote its paths, download inside it, and remove it after processing.

content.value_statement: Water interruptions can leave residents uncertain about affected areas and expected restoration times. This skill guides assistants through official public notices and location-based summaries.
actual_capabilities: Guide retrieval of official outage notices through public JSON or UTF-8 CSV endpoints without API keys.
Guide filtering notices by county, administrative district, and time.
Summarize affected areas, estimated start and restoration times, causes, and household counts when available.
Distinguish water outages from pressure reduction notices.
Report empty notice lists and provide published service office contact numbers.
Explain coverage exclusions and suggest the 1910 hotline for unlisted interruptions within Taiwan Water Corporation service areas.
limitations: Coverage excludes Taipei Water Department service areas, Kinmen, and Matsu.
Sudden pipe failures may not appear immediately; an empty list does not prove uninterrupted water service.
Water bills and water quality information are outside the skill scope.
Retrieval requires network access and curl or equivalent tools; endpoint failures and varying date formats require checking.

use_cases.title: Check a household interruption
use_cases.description: Find notices matching a resident location and explain estimated restoration times or appropriate support contacts.
use_cases.target_user: Residents in Taiwan Water Corporation service areas

use_cases.title: Prepare a building notice
use_cases.description: Summarize affected areas, timing, outage type, and published contact details for a building announcement.

use_cases.title: Review district notices
use_cases.description: Compare published outages and pressure reductions across selected districts using available timing, causes, and household counts.

prompt_templates.title: Check my area
prompt_templates.prompt: Check current water outage notices for [county] and [district]. State the query time and explain whether this location is covered.

prompt_templates.title: Find restoration details
prompt_templates.prompt: Find notices affecting [area] on [date]. Report the outage type, affected area, estimated restoration time, and published contact number.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a resident update
prompt_templates.prompt: Review notices for [building area] during [time range]. Draft a brief resident update distinguishing outages from pressure reductions. Label restoration times as estimates.

prompt_templates.title: Compare districts carefully
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare notices for [district list] during [time range]. Confirm date formats and coverage. Separate empty results from retrieval failures and summarize available household counts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: multiple locations and data checks

output_examples.input: Illustrate a response when a successful query returns no notices for a covered district.
output: Illustrative result: No matching Taiwan Water Corporation outage or pressure reduction notices were found at the query time.
An unlisted interruption remains possible. Contact 1910 if water service is unavailable.

output_examples.input: Summarize a hypothetical supplied notice: a covered area, planned outage from 09:00 to 17:00, reservoir cleaning, and 1,200 affected households.
output: Illustrative notice: A planned water outage affects the listed area from 09:00, with restoration estimated for 17:00.
The stated cause is reservoir cleaning, affecting approximately 1,200 households.
Restoration timing is an estimate, not a guarantee.

best_practices: Confirm the water provider and service area before interpreting notice results.
Include the query time and verify whether dates use Gregorian or Republic of China years.
Use private temporary files and verify successful retrieval before treating a response as an empty notice list.
anti_patterns: Treating an empty notice list as proof that every household has water.
Using Taiwan Water Corporation results for Taipei Water Department service areas.
Presenting estimated restoration times as guaranteed commitments.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No. The documented JSON and CSV endpoints provide public data without authentication.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Live queries require an environment with network access and suitable retrieval tools.

faq.question: Does this cover all of Taiwan?
faq.answer: No. It covers Taiwan Water Corporation service areas, excluding Taipei Water Department areas, Kinmen, and Matsu.

faq.question: What does an empty result mean?
faq.answer: A valid empty response means no notices are listed in that source. Sudden interruptions may still be unlisted.

faq.question: Can it check water bills or water quality?
faq.answer: No. The skill is limited to outage and pressure reduction notices.

faq.question: What happens if the data source is unavailable?
faq.answer: The guidance recommends one retry after several minutes, then reporting a source failure. It should not be described as no outages.
